title: Multi-User and Misuse AEL Security for HOMA
summary: HOMA's existing AEL-security proof excludes multi-user and misuse settings; extending the notion and proving HOMA secure there remains open.

formal_statement.body: Extend AEL security to the multi-user and misuse settings by allowing multiple users and adversarial misuse queries, and prove HOMA secure under this extended notion. HOMA's existing AEL-security proof does not cover these settings.

scope.domain: Authenticated-encryption security for HOMA under multi-user and misuse extensions of AEL security.
parameters: Multiple users, defining the multi-user extension
Adversarial misuse queries, defining the misuse extension
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove HOMA secure under the AEL-security notion extended to both settings.

citations.label: Secret Can Be Public: Low-Memory AEAD Mode for High-Order Masking

progress.summary: The paper states that its HOMA security proof does not cover multi-user or misuse settings and describes extending AEL security with multiple users and misuse queries. A proof for HOMA under that extension remains unresolved.
citation_labels: Yusuke Naito et al., Secret Can Be Public: Low-Memory AEAD Mode for High-Order Masking
